title: Add a second input to one PS2 button safely
summary: Use the Shift-click mapping menu to let a controller and keyboard activate the same emulated button, then test and remove only the added binding if needed.
heroAlt: Close view of the four face buttons on a DualShock 2 controller.
author: EmuCore - Hub
searchKeywords: map keyboard and controller to one ps2 button
Add a second input to one PS2 button safely

blocks.text: PCSX2 can stack multiple PC inputs on one PS2 button. This supports a keyboard fallback beside a gamepad or an accessibility switch that triggers the same in-game action. It does not create another PS2 controller port and is not a per-game profile. Additional inputs activate the same target whenever this mapping set is active.

Choose a noncritical menu button and note its current controller binding. Ensure the keyboard key is not already a PCSX2 hotkey or operating-system shortcut. Close the game before editing shared mappings; use a title-specific input profile when the alternate key should affect only one game. Do not use Clear Mapping, because it removes the existing port mappings.

items: 1. Open Settings > Controllers and select Controller Port 1.
2. Find the PS2 button whose existing controller binding you want to preserve.
3. Hold Shift while clicking that mapping button to open the additional-input menu.
4. Choose the add-input action and press the keyboard key once; ensure it appears beside the controller binding.
5. Save or close settings without clearing the original mapping.
6. Test the controller by itself in a safe menu, then test the keyboard key by itself.

blocks.text: Pass when either input independently activates the same PS2 button and unrelated controls remain unchanged. Test a tap and release so a held key is not mistaken for repeated presses. Stop if a PCSX2 hotkey or desktop overlay also fires; choose a different key before using the setup in a long session.

items: Shift-click shows no menu: click the mapping button itself, not the port heading.
The key replaced the controller: remove that entry and repeat through the additional-input menu.
Both inputs trigger pause: check PCSX2 hotkeys and desktop overlays for conflicts.
The game ignores the mapping: verify the edited port and active profile assigned to the game.

blocks.text: Right-click only the extra keyboard entry and clear it, preserving the controller input. Test the controller again in the same menu. If the duplicate belongs to a title profile, restore that profile or reassign the shared profile instead of changing unrelated games.
